tooltip.combatnexus.vanilla_combat.fire_: Successful melee attacks ignite the target.
tooltip.combatnexus.vanilla_combat.flame: Fired arrows burn and can ignite targets on hit.
tooltip.combatnexus.vanilla_combat.thorn: A qualifying random roll retaliates against the attacker and consumes equipment durability.
tooltip.combatnexus.vanilla_combat.bane_: Qualifying attacks also apply Slowness IV to arthropods; duration depends on level and a random roll.
tooltip.combatnexus.vanilla_combat.chann: During a thunderstorm, a qualifying trident hit with open sky summons lightning.
tooltip.combatnexus.vanilla_combat.wind_: A successful smash creates a wind burst that launches the wielder upward.

tooltip.combatnexus.vanilla_combat.ripti: When wet, using the trident propels the wielder into a spinning attack instead of throwing it.
tooltip.combatnexus.vanilla_combat.loyal: After impact, a thrown trident returns to its eligible owner; return speed increases with level.
tooltip.combatnexus.vanilla_combat.multi: Fires multiple projectiles per crossbow shot without consuming extra ammunition; firing still consumes durability.
tooltip.combatnexus.vanilla_combat.pierc: Crossbow arrows pass through additional entities and bypass item blocking; penetration count depends on level.

tooltip.combatnexus.vanilla_combat.block: Active blocking reduces eligible damage according to the item component and can consume durability.
tooltip.combatnexus.vanilla_combat.death: When native death-protection conditions succeed, consumes the item and applies its protection effects.
tooltip.combatnexus.vanilla_combat.insta: Instant healing: %s; deals %s to inverted-healing targets.
